final: WITH type_avgs AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY production_type_code), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS baseline_price FROM type_avgs), above_baseline AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.avg_price, b.baseline_price FROM type_avgs t CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE b.baseline_price IS NOT NULL AND t.avg_price > b.baseline_price), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS kept_mean_price FROM above_baseline), remaining AS (SELECT a.avg_price, a.baseline_price, m.kept_mean_price FROM above_baseline a CROSS JOIN kept_mean m WHERE a.avg_price > m.kept_mean_price) SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS mean_type_average_price, AVG(avg_price - baseline_price) AS mean_above_overall_baseline, AVG(avg_price - kept_mean_price) AS mean_above_kept_types_mean FROM remaining
